item.title: The data center backlash is reshaping American politics — one community at a time
item.description: With striking speed, the widespread debate around data centers has become a fault line in American communities, cutting across political parties and forging unexpected alliances.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: World leaders gather in New York for U.N. General Assembly, Trump says his proposed D.C. arch will be "military complex," FAA rolls out AI-enhanced software to manage nation's skies.

item.title: Diesel -- the fuel the U.S. economy runs on -- hits record high
item.description: Diesel prices continue setting records, now above $6.50 a gallon. That could mean higher prices not just for truckers, but for everyone.
item.content:encoded: Diesel prices continue setting records, now above $6.50 a gallon. That could mean higher prices not just for truckers, but for everyone.

item.title: How rising diesel fuel costs are affecting American farmers
item.description: NPR's Michel Martin asks John Boyd Jr. of the National Black Farmers Association how farmers are affected by record high diesel fuel costs.

item.title: Hundreds vie for the chance to become the new voice of Boston's Logan Airport
item.description: Hundreds of people answered Boston's Logan Airport's open casting call to find an authentic local voice for announcements.

item.description: President Trump says his planned arch will also serve as a military complex as he faces pushback on his multiple construction projects in the nation's capital.

item.title: FAA to launch AI-enhanced software to help manage the nation's airspace
item.description: Regulators at the Federal Aviation Administration are preparing to roll out AI-enhanced software in an $875 million overhaul to manage the nation's airspace.

item.title: U.S. citizen's detention in China may be a topic of discussion during D.C. visit
item.description: In June, U.S. citizen and prominent Myanmar scholar Min Zin was taken into custody in China. Min Zin's detention will likely be on the agenda during Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington.
item.content:encoded: In June, U.S. citizen and prominent Myanmar scholar Min Zin was taken into custody in China. Min Zin's detention will likely be on the agenda during Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington.

item.title: Federal immigration agent shoots and injures man in Austin, Texas
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security said Monday it was leading the investigation into the officer involved in a shooting of "an illegal alien from Venezuela" during an operation in Austin, Texas.
item.content:encoded:
The Department of Homeland Security said Monday it was leading the investigation into the officer involved in a shooting of "an illegal alien from Venezuela" during an operation in Austin, Texas.
